item.title: Cloud based functionality makes Abila an attractive option
item.dc:creator: soniya.bajoria@communitybrands.com
item.content:encoded: Abila MIP Advance is a sophisticated, cloud-based true fund accounting solution that delivers powerful reporting, analytics, and dashboards. This tool is available with a responsive web interface which is optimized for mobile devices. This further adds to the usefulness of the software at large as it is accessible from anywhere. It is a true fund accounting solution well suited for mid-sized nonprofits and government entities that manage multiple funds and require advanced reporting capability. It offers a lot of add-on modules that increase functionality tremendously. It offers the ability to use a flexible chart of accounts with the ability to utilize unlimited segments, making it easy to users to manage multiple funds and programs. it can handle multiple transaction types like cash receipts, journal entries, and bank reconciliations. The Dashboard also contains a series of charts that display trends and offer a current year analysis. An advanced warning system can be set up and maintained to notify users if close to a budget overage. And the what-if scenario allows users to enter transactions to see what net effect the transactions would have on budgets. As there are less number of people using this system currently, the training administrators for the tool are also less and so are expensive too. Since training is required at the initial stage of using the program, it is an additional cost to the business during the shift to Abila.

item.title: MCE created a bespoke on line registration, e-commerce, CRM program for our sports company.
item.dc:creator: soniya.bajoria@communitybrands.com
item.content:encoded: The team at MCE were selected to create an e commerce platform for Challenger Sports that would allow hundreds of thousands of customers each year to search, register and pay for one of our 5,000+ soccer coaching programs throughout North America. They also created an on line shop that acted both as a stand alone store and as an additional revenue source during the registration process. Following the successful launch of this application, MCE created a custom CRM program for Challenger which is now used to manage the sales and marketing process of over 100 employees in 12 offices. The transition from our previous program took several months to complete and as with any change we encountered challenges and issues that we did not anticipate. Each time MCE were quick to respond and frequently worked outside of traditional office hours to correct the problems. The event registration application has proved be extremely robust and we have had no bandwidth issues with hundreds of customers registering at the same time. MCE also provides a built in email marketing program which has not only proved to be extremely useful but has also saved money that was previously spent on stand alone email marketing fees. The MCE application has an initially intimidating learning curve due to the large number of controls and flexibility given to each user to customize the environment, variable data, images, videos, copy, transaction emails and financial set up of the events being run. However if my team of British Soccer coaches can master the process then I am confident others in business should have no problem!

Not only did MCE assist me in every way that they could during the first few months of my contract to make the change go smoothly, they ensured that I receive the same customer care to this day. It's important to me that I can pick up the phone (even though their company is on pacific time, and we are eastern) and know that I am going to speak with someone who knows my program and who can help me work through any issues I may be having. MCE worked hard to make sure that I was a happy customer from day 1, designing our camper scheduling that had always been a huge, stressful, paper project each summer. item.title: Thank you volunteer matters!
item.dc:creator: soniya.bajoria@communitybrands.com
item.content:encoded: The Pavek Museum’s current volunteer program is only about two years old. Initially, we used Sign Up Genius. However, we recognized that as the program grew, we would require volunteer management software capable of handling more tasks beyond shift sign up such as tracking hours, generating reports, and creating more specific project roles. Our [sensitive content hidden] had previous experience with VolunteerMatters. After conducting thorough research and comparing it with other software options, we decided on VolunteerMatters. I can already see how much time it saves me as the manager of the volunteer program. For our volunteers, it streamlines the sign-up process, providing them with more information about the shifts or projects upfront, and it automatically tracks their hours, eliminating the need for manual tracking as they used to do. We used Sign Up Genius when we created the new program, but we needed a volunteer management software that could enhance volunteers' experience with us, making it more seamless, and also save staff time by automating tasks like sending reminder emails and tracking hours.

item.title: MIP-one of our best choices!
item.dc:creator: soniya.bajoria@communitybrands.com
item.content:encoded: MIP Fund Accounting is our sole accounting software from AP, AR, budgeting, and general ledger. It allows the use of grant tracking easily. It also allows an efficient method for tracking custodial funds (approx. 50+ checking accounts for individuals, approximately 25 shared accounts of those served) that are audited quarterly by the state agency. It also allows tracking of those persons' accounts that we bill for various expenses that the agency forwards the funding for (until reimbursed by either the individual or their funding source). These are essential tasks that require constant monitoring.

item.title: MIP Works for Non-Profits
item.dc:creator: soniya.bajoria@communitybrands.com
item.content:encoded: We use it for our payables, our payroll, our receivables, reporting, budgeting. It's nice to have all aspects of accounting under the same program, making reporting consistent. We recently moved to the Cloud (about 18 months ago). I like the Cloud, but am constantly kicked out of it and there seems to be no resolution for it. The classic version works 99.9% of the time and I am often using that over the Cloud version because it consistently stays available.
